title: Charlie Red Star sighting at Carman, Manitoba

tellings.quote: So, we turned the car to go back in and boom, it appeared from the left to the right.

plain: A man named Grant Cameron told podcast host Jesse Michels about a night in May 1975 near Carman, a small town in Manitoba, Canada, where people had been reporting a strange light nicknamed Charlie Red Star. Cameron says that as they turned the car to head back, the light suddenly appeared and crossed in front of them from left to right, which he offers as his own first-hand look at it.
